qualitative_activity_findings.finding: The paper reports no antibacterial effect for these three synthesized peptides against the studied isolates within the tested 0-32 ug/mL concentration range; no per-isolate supplementary MIC matrix for these inactive peptides is present in the local supplement.
The local text reports HAPPENN scores for PEP-137, PEP-136, PEP-36, and PEP-38, and contains a likely PEP-134 typo; it does not support a numeric HAPPENN score for PEP-174.
